summary: Frontend-only verification of KPI card refactor (removed decorative sparklines, added labeled meter bar). Logged in via mock auth (empty fields) → dashboard-page renders. Verified all 3 KPI cards (rv-tile-open, rv-tile-total, rv-tile-forecast) show: value, caption, '<pct>% <label>' meter text, and a filled .rv-kpi-bar i with width>0. .rv-kpi-spark selector count = 0 (removed). Percentages update per segment and cap at 100%. Regression selectors (rv-goal-pct, rv-range-*, revenue-tooltip, rv-export-btn, rv-segment-us/dist, rv-top-account-1..5, rv-account-row-lids expand) all pass with 0 page errors.

ui_bugs.component: DashboardPage rv-hero (pre-existing from iteration_24, unchanged in this pass)
ui_bugs.issue: Segment pills (rv-seg-all/us/dist) render on their own row ABOVE the eyebrow/figure at 1920 (pill y=122 vs fig y=155) — not on same row as $11,572,416 figure. Layout is still balanced (no overlap / no large empty gaps) but does not match 'top-right same row' spec.

verification_details.kpi_forecast_all: rv-tile-forecast: value=$17.3M, cap='full-year projection', meter='100% of annual goal', inline width=100%, rendered bar ≈ 321px.
verification_details.segment_switch: US: open 44% / total 100% / fc 100%. Dist: open 45% / total 100% / fc 94%. Back to All: matches baseline.
verification_details.capping: Total (all) computed pct=120% → displayed and bar width both capped at 100%. Confirmed via Math.min(pct,100).
verification_details.regression: rv-goal-pct=1, rv-export-btn=1, rv-segment-us=1, rv-segment-dist=1, rv-top-account-1..5 all present, rv-account-row-lids expand → rv-account-expand-lids visible, rv-range-ytd/12m/q clickable, revenue-tooltip appears on chart hover (visible=True).
verification_details.layout_1920: KPI cards render as 2x2 bento: rv-goal-card (x=1120,y=92,w=371,h=201) and rv-tile-open (x=1511,y=92,h=201) on row1; rv-tile-total (x=1120,y=313,h=196) and rv-tile-forecast (x=1511,y=313,h=196) on row2. No overlap, no large empty gaps, symmetric heights (Δh=5px within row group).

action_items: (Carried over from iter 24, not part of this fix) Hero segment pills placement: consider putting them inline with the figure ($11,572,416) on the same row rather than on their own row above the eyebrow.
critical_code_review_comments: KPI pct computed inline in kpis array using Math.round((h.open/h.total)*100) and (h.total/h.goalTarget)*100 — clean, and Math.min(t.pct,100) applied in both the number label AND the bar width, so cap is consistent.
Consider adding aria-label to .rv-kpi-bar (progressbar role) for accessibility since it now represents a metric.
test_credentials: Mock auth: click 'Log in' with empty fields.
context_for_next_testing_agent: KPI card refactor verified green. Sparklines removed (.rv-kpi-spark=0), meter bars render at correct widths and cap at 100%, percentages update across segments. Only outstanding UI note is the hero pill placement (pre-existing from iter 24, low priority).
